notes.title: PHP 8.5.12 fixes two critical remote code execution flaws in PHP itself (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619). Update promptly
WebUI hardening from the security audit: XML-RPC code execution limited to uid 0, captive portal and CSRF checks, widget disconnect by POST, safe unserialize, shell escaping
VXLAN: a multicast group port now follows the local port
Supersedes 1.1.9; nothing to do first. Systems on 1.1.1 to 1.1.4 still need the one-time console command from the 1.1.5 notes
